 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. According to NFL insider Jordan Schultz, the Philadelphia Eagles are set to waive former Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Marquise 'Hollywood' Brown after both parties agreed that a separation would be mutually "beneficial."
 Brown spent his 2024 and 2025 campaigns in Kansas City after stints with the Baltimore Ravens and Arizona Cardinals .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He started his career as a first-round pick of the Ravens in the 2019 NFL Draft. The speedy wideout put together a 1,000-yard season with Baltimore in 2021, but injuries have affected Brown's availability in recent years.
 Take a look at Schultz's full report on Brown's departure from Philadelphia, which was posted to Twitter on the insider's official account:
 Even after Kansas City's acquisition of pass-catcher Josh Downs in a last-minute deal with the Indianapolis Colts at the 2026 NFL trade deadline, the Chiefs could still use another veteran presence to shore up the depth of their receiving corps, and fans shouldn't be surprised if general manager Brett Veach decides to reunite with Brown on the waiver wire.
